name: Ragnaros
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 1,626 to 2,671 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 2.40 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 27 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2024-12-13 to 2025-02-27): the median of 424 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (2,144), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (424 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,338 weapon damage, spread 0.781, a 2.00 s swing. Length: the main tank's time on him a kill, median 71 s (10th to 90th percentile 46 to 101). Weapon damage abilities: Elemental Fire 20564 18.9 a minute of tanking. Abilities: Elemental Fire 20564: 2,160 to 2,640 Fire and 600 Fire a second for 8 s (the Classic Era client's spell data; Wowhead confirms the duration), a proc on his landed hits at the logs' rate.
abilitiesSource: Elemental Fire 20564: 2,160 to 2,640 Fire and 600 Fire a second for 8 s (the Classic Era client's spell data; Wowhead confirms the duration), a proc on his landed hits at the logs' rate.
notes: Elemental Fire is a proc on his landed hits, blocked ones too (proc aura 20563, client data), at the logs' rate: on the Anniversary realms about 3 in 4 of his swings, in Season of Discovery's Normal far fewer. Its DoT is 8 ticks of 600, restarted by the next hit. Fire resistance from gear and buffs takes its share. Wrath of Ragnaros (every 25 to 30 s, 1,000 Fire and a knockback that wipes threat, so a second tank picks him up) and the submerge phase are left out: one tank's stint between knockbacks is what's scored.

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (27 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 6 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 1,710 a second with overheal and absorbs (40% of the heals effective), 2.09 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 725 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (1% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 23, Druid 4.

raidHealing.notes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Ragnaros (27 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 2 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 0 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (79% of the healing), each 322 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 2,737 a second (821 on the tanks, 1,823 on the rest, 26% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 47.5 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: the Anniversary Hardcore realms] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 27 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/anniversary_mc_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 97% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.03 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Lava Burst 21158 from Lionfish (62% of the non-tanks' damage, in 27 of 27 kills): 924 to 1,077 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 23% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 59), 29.5 landed a second on each (84% of it landing), so a cast every 5.5 s at random (the logs count 7.6 casts a minute), the first at 14 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Intense Heat 21155 from Flame of Ragnaros (30% of the non-tanks' damage, in 27 of 27 kills): 2,000 to 2,000 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 11% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 16), 14.2 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 12.54 s at random (the logs count 4.9 casts a minute), the first at 12 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Lava 6 from Environment (5% of the non-tanks' damage, in 27 of 27 kills): 117 to 636 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 6), 2.2 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 3.67 s at random (the logs count 6.3 casts a minute), the first at 17 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Together they land 47.5 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 47.5 in the logs.
